scenario: The ego vehicle follows a car through an intersection while a bus turns right from the right side.

ego.behavior: The car follows the lead car straight through the intersection, maintaining a safe following distance.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight ahead through the intersection and gradually decelerates as it approaches the traffic lights.
The bus turns right from the right-side road, crossing in front of the ego vehicle's path before exiting the intersection area.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a multi-lane road approaching a signalized intersection, following a lead car in the same lane, while a bus enters from a right-side road and turns right across the intersection.
requirements_and_restrictions: The traffic light is green for the ego vehicle's direction; the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle clears the intersection.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right side of the road near the intersection.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the dashboard camera vehicle; lead car and turning bus are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: two adversarials (one Car, one NPCCar/bus). 3. Chronology: initially ego follows lead car approaching intersection; midpoint bus appears from right and turns right; ending ego continues through intersection as bus exits frame and lead car slows. 4. Evidence: bus visible in frame 3 entering from right, then turns and exits; lead car's brake lights illuminate in later frames indicating deceleration.
